metrics.summary: Root cause: `_set_path` in `appcfg/loader.py` did `node = node[k]` while walking env-override paths, so any `APP__...` override whose intermediate section (e.g. `APP__CACHE__REDIS__URL` when no `cache` key exists) was absent from DEFAULTS/the config file raised `KeyError: 'cache'` — exactly the staging crash. Fix: in `_set_path`, create a new dict for any missing intermediate key (`node.get(k)` → create `{}` and store it) before descending, while still applying `_coerce` on the leaf so existing keys keep their int/float/bool types and new keys stay strings. Verified: reproduced the staging env scenario (new `cache.redis.url` section created, `APP__DB__POOL__SIZE` coerced to int, `APP__HTTP__DEBUG` to False), confirmed `DEFAULTS` is not mutated (deep-copied in `load`), tested brand-new multi-level paths, and all 4 existing pytest tests pass.

import copy
from appcfg.loader import DEFAULTS, load

    "APP__DB__HOST": "db.staging.internal",

    "APP__CACHE__REDIS__URL": "redis://cache.staging.internal:6379/0",
    "APP__HTTP__DEBUG": "false",
}

print(cfg)
